pages.title: Hot off the Press
pages.text: Produce an Iron Sheet with a powered Mechanical Press.

pages.title: Hot off the Press
pages.text: Turn workshop motion into a useful building component; spare sheets support the next machines.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Feed an iron ingot to the press’s native work surface and power the press. Taking a found or gifted sheet does not count.

pages.title: How to use it
pages.text: Connect a power source, shafts and consumers so the machines receive rotational force. Basic automation that depends on mechanical stress.

pages.title: How to use it
pages.text: Power a Mechanical Press and give it a supported ingot input on a belt or beneath it. Processed material for machine crafting.

pages.title: Useful to know
pages.text: Use the configured tutorial action on an item with an interactive lesson. The scene explains operation but does not count as production; the actual machine must produce the result.
